paper_title: Bridging Cognition and Emotion Empathy-Driven Multimodal Misinformation   Detection
caption: Results of Ablation Study
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the results of an ablation study, comparing the accuracy of a model across different configurations. The horizontal axis displays six categories labeled "Ours," "w/o select emotion," "w/o text," "w/o cognition," "Ours w/o comments," "w/o select emotion," and "w/o cognition," with each category rotated for readability. The vertical axis, labeled "Accuracy (%)", ranges from 75 to 95 on a linear scale, with tick labels at 5-unit intervals. A total of six bars are presented, each corresponding to one of the labeled categories. The bars representing "Ours" and "Ours w/o comments" are colored in pink, with values of approximately 89.84 and 90.57, respectively. The remaining bars, representing the other configurations, are colored in blue, with values ranging from approximately 81.17 to 89.62. The shortest bar is "w/o cognition" at approximately 81.17, while the tallest is "Ours" at approximately 89.84. The bars are not sorted in a particular order, but three pink and three blue bars are presented adjacently. There is no specific visual emphasis applied to any single bar.
